issue_context.title: Songpal detects Sony TV
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Hi im not sure if this can be seen a problem or more of a annoyance.

My Songpal which i use for my Sony soundbar works fine but it also detects my Sony Bravia 8 TV. But no entities are detected, just an empty TV device under Songpal integration entries.

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b51ffe76-2a9d-4637-9a0c-8280edaeda88)


- Should the Songpal integration detect Sony TVs aswell, if no is this an issue(like to keep HA clean from any mot essential info)?

- If yes, why isnt any devices or entities detected?

core-2024.12.5

Hi,

The reason for this is that these devices use the same (discovery) protocol. [The integration tries to ignore bravia devices](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/1e420f16f7ea141487b190f588aba5fdc0e20d2f/homeassistant/components/songpal/config_flow.py#L118-L120) by ignoring devices which expose a specific service, but apparently that hasn't worked in your case.

Without further information it is hard to say why that's the case. I'm not sure what's the easiest way to do this (I thought enabling logging for discovery would do the trick), but you could try the instructions in https://github.com/rytilahti/python-songpal?tab=readme-ov-file#locating-the-endpoint and paste the list of services your TV reports. If we are lucky, this will be fixed by adding another service to that blocklist.

Ran below but didnt get any services discovered:
```
# songpal discover
Discovering for 5 seconds
INFO:songpal.discovery:Discovering for 5 seconds
```

This is the relevant error why it fails:
```
Got an error for getSystemInformation: [403, 'Forbidden']: Unknown error 403: Forbidden
```
Looking at the list of services your device exposes, "video" seems to be something we can use to avoid getting this device recognized as songpal device. The linked PR does just that.
Nice, im guessing that the new bravias that was released this summer has this "problem". Thanks for quick response.

review_comments: is service_types a string? In that case you can remove the first option because `video` is also contained in `videoScreen`

Looking at tests and [this comment](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/133689#issuecomment-2557921344), it seems to be a list: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/67f0de441b489890efa802a325f187b761098ad6/tests/components/braviatv/test_config_flow.py#L58-L65

Yeah, it's a list indeed. Some newer bravias (https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/133689#issuecomment-2558122304) apparently do not have `videoScreen` anymore, hence the adjustment.

In the worst case, some supported devices won't be discovered automatically, but the known supported soundbars (based on grep 'video' on https://github.com/rytilahti/python-songpal/tree/master/devinfos) do not seem to expose neither, so I think we can risk false negatives here for better UX for TV users.
Would be nicer if it was a `set` so avoid the linear search but its so short it won't matter so much in practice.
